details:
The new notification for vote kicks in it's new form does not display enough information in it's new form. While the new notification could potentially be useful, it leaves a lot to be desired. When it shows up, it displayed, "A vote kick was been initiated ...". If this new HUD is meant to help provide information at a glance, and help provide useful information, then a way to do this would be to provide the full information behind vote kick information.

This would help to go towards improving response times for those of us who do group moderation by being able to see, "Vote kick was initiated against x by y" at a glance through this notification, rather than going through the quick menu. (Which we do anyways or through other means just to double check). I would also suggest letting the notification for this persist slightly longer as it would provide valuable information for group moderators, not only that but for regular users within a group it would be useful just to have the standard "A vote kick has been initiated against x" at a glance.

Attached is a screenshot of the current notification in the Open Beta.
title: [Open Beta 1912] Moderation Vote Kick Notification Doesn't Display Enough Information
